questions.q: Which empire had its capital at Tenochtitlan?
questions.why: Mexico City stands on its site.

questions.q: Which Spanish conquistador conquered the Aztecs in 1521?
questions.why: He arrived in 1519.

questions.q: On what date is Mexico's Independence Day?

questions.q: Which priest started the independence war with the 'Cry of Dolores'?

questions.q: What does Cinco de Mayo commemorate?

questions.why: The battle was in 1862.

questions.q: Which civilisation built Chichén Itzá?
questions.why: Its pyramid is El Castillo.

questions.q: Which revolution began in 1910?
questions.why: Revolution Day is 20 November.

questions.q: Which revolutionary leader from Morelos fought for 'land and liberty'?

questions.q: Which northern revolutionary general was nicknamed 'the Centaur of the North'?
questions.why: He raided Columbus, New Mexico, in 1916.

questions.q: Which Zapotec president led liberal reforms in the 1850s–60s?

questions.q: Which dictator ruled Mexico for over 30 years before 1911?

questions.q: Which Austrian archduke was made Emperor of Mexico in 1864?

questions.q: Which ancient city near Mexico City has the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon?

questions.q: Who became Mexico's first woman President, in 2024?
questions.why: She is a climate scientist and former mayor of Mexico City.

questions.q: What is the capital of Mexico?
questions.why: It is one of the world's largest cities.

questions.q: Which peninsula is home to Cancún?
questions.why: It is famous for cenotes.

questions.q: Which country borders Mexico to the north?
questions.why: The border is about 3,100 km long.

questions.q: What are natural limestone sinkholes in the Yucatán called?

questions.q: Which long peninsula lies along the Pacific in the northwest?

questions.q: Which city is famous for mariachi and tequila?

questions.q: Which river forms part of the US–Mexico border?

questions.q: What is Mexico's highest mountain?

questions.q: Which active volcano near Mexico City is nicknamed 'Popo'?

questions.q: Which huge canyon system in Chihuahua is bigger than the Grand Canyon?

questions.q: How many states does Mexico have?

questions.q: Which volcano was born in a cornfield in 1943?

questions.q: Which city is Mexico's main industrial city in the north?

questions.q: Which UNESCO-listed canals in Mexico City are toured on colourful boats?

questions.q: Which Mexico City stadium has hosted two World Cup finals?

questions.q: What is Mexico's national football team nicknamed?

questions.q: Which Mexican boxer is known as 'Canelo'?
questions.why: He has won titles in four weight classes.

questions.q: Which Formula One driver from Guadalajara is called 'Checo'?

questions.q: Which cliff-diving show is famous in Acapulco?

questions.q: Which Mexican club is the most popular, nicknamed 'Las Águilas'?

questions.q: Who became Mexico's first female Olympic champion, at Sydney 2000?

questions.q: Which kind of Mexican band plays violins, trumpets and guitars in charro suits?

questions.q: Which Mexican director made 'Gravity' and 'Roma'?

questions.q: Which Mexican comedian played 'El Chavo del Ocho'?

questions.q: Which comic actor starred as a vagabond 'peladito'?

questions.q: Which Nobel-winning poet wrote 'The Labyrinth of Solitude'?

questions.why: Each chapter begins with a recipe.

questions.q: Which holiday honours dead loved ones with altars and marigolds?

questions.q: Which avocado dip comes from Mexico?

questions.q: Which rich sauce often contains chillies and chocolate?

questions.q: What are corn dough parcels steamed in husks called?

questions.q: Which grain, first domesticated in Mexico, is the base of tortillas?

questions.q: Which brightly painted fantasy creatures come from Oaxaca and Mexico City?

questions.q: Which Oaxaca festival in July celebrates Indigenous dances?

questions.q: What is Mexico's currency?
questions.why: The $ sign was first used for the peso.

questions.q: What is shown in the centre of Mexico's flag?
questions.a: An eagle eating a snake on a cactus
questions.why: It recalls the Aztec founding legend.

questions.q: Which country has the most Spanish speakers in the world?
questions.why: It has over 120 million people.

questions.q: Which Mexican chocolate drink is often frothed with a wooden whisk?

questions.q: Which butterfly migrates to Mexico's forests every winter?
questions.why: Millions gather in Michoacán.

questions.q: What is Mexico City's main square called?
questions.why: Its official name is Plaza de la Constitución.

questions.q: Which Indigenous language with over a million speakers comes from the Aztecs?
questions.why: Words like 'chocolate' and 'tomato' come from it.

questions.q: What is Mexico's national animal?
questions.why: It appears on the flag.

questions.q: Which salamander from Xochimilco never grows up?
